title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the entropy difference must be correctly stated as Delta S = 0.97 cal/K.

title: Moles Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the number of moles of nitrogen must be correctly performed as n = 1/28.

title: Entropy Change Gas
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the entropy change for the ideal gas must be correctly derived using Delta S' = nC_p ln(T_1/T_2).

title: Entropy Change Phase Transition
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the entropy change during the phase transition must be correctly derived using Delta S'' = nL/T_2.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units for all calculations must be consistent and correctly stated throughout the solution.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the calculations of entropy changes.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing the conversion of temperatures from Celsius to Kelvin can lead to incorrect results.
